ambient_events: A plate settles against another plate with a flat concrete knock.
The bar rolls an inch in its rack and stops against the weld.
Chalk dust turns over slowly in the light from the cage lamp.
Somebody's count is still scratched into the paint, and stops at forty-one.
description: A concrete box the precinct calls the exercise room and everyone else calls the pit. No windows, no mirrors, no music — one caged lamp, a bench bolted through the slab, and a bar loaded with plates poured out of the same concrete as the walls, because anything a man could unbolt is something a man could swing. The far wall is a tally in four different hands, each one counting something nobody wrote down. It smells of chalk, old sweat, and the drain next door. The cages are back east.
name: The Pit
